session_dialogue.text: Hello. How are you feeling today?
I'm feeling a bit anxious today. I keep thinking about Jersey and all the things I can't do for her right now.
I can see how that might feel overwhelming. Let's focus on what we can control right now.
I know I should focus on my own life, but it's hard when I feel like I'm failing Jersey. I keep worrying I'm not doing enough.
It's completely normal to feel that way. Let's break down what you're actually doing for Jersey and what you're not.
I'm cooking meals for her and helping with some of the daily tasks, but I can't be there in person like I want to. I feel like I'm still not enough, even though I'm trying.
It sounds like you're doing a lot already. Let's talk about how you're feeling when you're not able to be there in person.
I get really tense and scared when I can't be there. I keep thinking about how I'm not helping enough, and it makes me feel like I'm not good enough for anyone.
That’s a heavy feeling to carry. Let’s try to understand what it would look like if you were able to be there for Jersey.
I’d feel like I could actually help her the way she needs, but I’m stuck with my own stuff right now. It’s like I can’t even breathe when I think about it.
It sounds like your own struggles are really impacting how you feel about yourself. Let’s try to explore what you need from yourself in this moment.
I need to stop punishing myself for not being able to do more. I need to remember that I’m doing what I can, even if it’s not enough.
That’s an important realization. Let’s try to name the parts of yourself that are feeling guilty and see if we can give them some space.
The part of me that feels guilty is always whispering that I’m not enough, that I’m failing everyone. I just want it to stop talking.
It’s like that voice is a part of you that’s been hurt. Let’s try to listen to it without judgment and see what it’s really trying to tell you.
It’s saying I’m not good enough, that I’ll always be a burden. It’s scared I’ll be alone again, like I was before. I don’t know how to make it stop.
That voice is carrying a lot of fear and pain. Let’s try to sit with it for a moment and see if we can understand where it’s coming from.
It’s coming from the times I felt like I wasn’t enough for my friends, the times I was left alone when I needed support. It’s like it’s afraid I’ll lose them again if I don’t do everything perfectly.
That makes sense. It sounds like that voice is trying to protect you, even if it’s doing it in a painful way. Let’s try to see if we can soften that part of you and give it the care it needs.
I don’t know how to care for that part of me. It feels so far away, like it’s always been broken. I just want it to feel safe.
